title: Gen-CR
fill_note: DENSE layered wind with a jig; scorer cap 0.65
fill_how: The scored turns assume a dense, layer-by-layer wind at fill 0.65 (insulated-wire area / window; the scorer cap). Use a winding jig on a drill/lathe with a turn counter, lay each layer side-by-side with light back-tension, and do not scramble-wind: a scramble wind only reaches ≈0.55–0.60 and then the window holds fewer turns (scorer what-if `--fill 0.60` is in the table above). Never wind more than the listed turns — the copper must stay below the flanges.
steel_extra: **New steel:** Ø204 discs, M3 clamp map R30 at 0/90/180/270° and R44 on the inter-pole angles 67.5/112.5/247.5/292.5° (both inside the R89 magnet ring). Cut from this kit's `steel_backiron_disc.dxf`; no earlier disc fits.
o5_note: 48 DIAMETRIC Ø5×5 fitted, 3 per inter-pole gap (R81.6/87.8/94), Halbach-oriented (rule engraved on every arc)
card_title: Gen-CR · 8p/12c · T-pole DEEP-WINDOW (R89, 313 t, r60 bobbins)
card_sub: Ø20 N52 @R89 + N42 @R73.4 (20 mm tangential) keyhole · 48 diametric Ø5 · bobbins r60–105.5 × 4.65 mm, 16.5 mm radial build, 313 t · 2× Ø204 steel · 2026-10-19
idea: The T-pole pushed 1 mm further out (disc R89, block crossbar r68.4–78.4, Ø204 steel = the largest rotor that still clears the R109.5 frame rods) with a deeper bobbin window: copper sector r60–105.5 with a 16.5 mm radial build, so each coil carries 313 turns in a narrower, more central ring of copper (same ≈386 m of wire). Ø5 columns at R81.6/87.8/94.0.
retro_md:
## Modular notes (Gen-CR)

Frame (R109.5 rods), bearing bridges, shaft and collars as Gen-CJ/CP. New: Ø204 steel discs (clamp ring R89 ±13°), 16 arcs (T-pole at R89), stator with bobbins r60–105.5 × 4.65 mm × 16.5 mm build (313 t). Not interchangeable with Gen-CP's rotors (different pole radius). Swap stators with the 4 temporary M4 jack rods (raise rotor B on the nuts, never by hand).
steel_note: Steel: 2× Ø204 × 4.76 mm (3/16") mild-steel discs, clamp map hub M3 at R22 0/90/180/270°, 4× Ø4.3 brace holes R18 at 45/135/225/315°, 16 arc-clamp M3 at R89 ±13° from every pole, index notch at +X — cut from this kit's `steel_backiron_disc.dxf` (laser-cut service). Lobed arcs: 2.4 mm PLA around each pocket; the epoxy-to-steel bond, not the PLA, holds the magnets. New discs (Ø204, R89 clamp ring).
